Subject: Update on Today’s Deployment Timeline

Hi [Manager Name],

I wanted to give you a quick, clear update on why today’s deployment was delayed and what I’m doing to prevent a repeat.

During the final pre-deploy checks, we found an issue with [briefly describe issue at a high level, e.g., “data integrity in the new reporting endpoint”]. Proceeding would have introduced a real risk of [brief impact, e.g., “incorrect data being shown to customers”], so I made the call to pause the deployment and work with [relevant team/person] to validate a fix.

Current status:
- The root cause has been identified as [1 short line, e.g., “a mismatch between the new schema and an existing service”].
- A fix is in place and is currently being tested in [environment].
- Assuming tests pass, I expect to deploy by [new ETA]. I’ll confirm once it’s complete.

To reduce the chance of this happening again, I’m:
- Adding an automated check for [the specific issue] to our pre-deployment pipeline.
- Updating our deployment checklist to include [1–2 specific steps].
- Scheduling a short retrospective with the team to capture learnings.

I recognize this delay impacts [project/stakeholders], and I take responsibility for ensuring we ship safely and predictably. Please let me know if you’d like more detail or a quick call to walk through the timeline and mitigations.

Best,  
[Your Name]

---

If you share the specific issue and context (production/staging, who was affected, etc.), I can tighten the wording and details so you can send it as-is.
